gist.headline: Arabic Login Takes Flight
gist.blurb: A new flower joined the image garden: baboolharech, a browser-only Arabic app that brings Pollinations BYOP login along for the ride. No backend shed required.
gist.summary: Added baboolharech to the image app directory: a static Arabic RTL web app that implements the Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely client-side.
gist.impact: Arabic-speaking builders can discover a client-only reference app for connecting to Pollinations.ai through the BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE flow without running a backend server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict baboolharech as a welcoming Arabic RTL client-side login garden: a retro browser window with a right-to-left login panel, a tiny key and secure path made of pixel flowers, showing that OAuth PKCE happens in the browser without a server. Polli should warmly guide the flow while wearing a small explorer scarf; add code-plants and a cozy terminal to connect it to the open image ecosystem.
